admin-only.doc:
Test fixture of the framework's test project for the group/staff access check; it shows only a static test heading.

- Only logged-in superusers may open it; staff status or group membership is not enough.
- Anyone else (anonymous or without permission) is redirected to `<sdc-login>`, with `next` pointing back to the parent view.
- The Jest tests also use it as an empty host controller for `SdcModel` tests; it changes no data itself.

book-edit.doc:
Demo form for one `Book`, used by the framework's tests; it reuses the `<sdc-model-form>` behaviour.

- Arguments: `pk` (or `id`) is the id of the book to edit; without it the form creates a new `Book`.
- In edit mode every field change is saved immediately via the model socket; there is no separate save button.
- "Add X to name" appends ` X` to the title and sets `author` to the author with id `1`, in the form's model object only (not saved by this button itself).
- Open to everyone, no login required.

editor-and-staff.doc:
Test fixture of the framework's test project for the group/staff access check; it shows only a static test heading.

- May be opened by logged-in users in group `Editor`, staff users and superusers.
- Anyone else (anonymous or without permission) is redirected to `<sdc-login>`, with `next` pointing back to the parent view.
- Shows and changes no data.

editor-no-staff.doc:
Test fixture of the framework's test project for the group/staff access check; it shows only a static test heading.

- May be opened by logged-in users in group `Editor` and superusers; staff status alone is not enough.
- Anyone else (anonymous or without permission) is redirected to `<sdc-login>`, with `next` pointing back to the parent view.
- Shows and changes no data.

error404.doc:
Test fixture of the framework's test project; it shows only the static test heading "Error404".

Despite its name it is not an error handler: it is open to everyone and shows and changes no data.

logged-in.doc:
Test fixture of the framework's test project; it shows only the static test heading "LoggedIn".

- Open to everyone; despite its name it does not require a login.
- Target of the `test_echo_call` server call of `<main-view>`, which redirects the browser to `/logged-in`.
- Shows and changes no data.

main-view.doc:
Demo page of the framework's test project, used by the Jest tests to exercise controller features; it has no real business purpose.

- Requires a logged-in user; anonymous users get a permission-denied (403) error instead of a login redirect.
- Shows a list of `<test-item>` children (initially 5) and a test header.
- "BB" removes one `<test-item>` from the list and sets the header to "Button Pressed!!"; the two unlabeled buttons only change the header text.
- Server calls `call_echo` and `call_async_echo` return their arguments and each create a new `Author` named `XX FF` (age `2`).
- Server call `test_echo_call` redirects the browser to `<logged-in>`; `call_no_response` does nothing.

staff-and-admin.doc:
Test fixture of the framework's test project for the group/staff access check; it shows only a static test heading.

- May be opened by logged-in staff users and superusers; no group grants access.
- Anyone else (anonymous or without permission) is redirected to `<sdc-login>`, with `next` pointing back to the parent view.
- Shows and changes no data.

test-item.doc:
Small demo list item inside `<main-view>`: a single text input named `i_<idx>`.

Argument `idx` is the item's position in the list; changing the input shows a browser alert with that `idx`. It saves no data and is open to everyone.

Author.doc:
Demo/test model of the framework's test project: an author of `Book` records.

- `name` (text, max. 255 characters) and `age` (integer, years); both required.
- Has no permission checks: anyone, even anonymous users, may read, create, edit and delete authors.
- Deleting an author also deletes all of that author's `Book` records.
- The list search matches `name` or the title of one of the author's books.
- Calling the `call_echo` / `call_async_echo` server calls of `<main-view>` creates an extra author `XX FF` (age `2`).

Book.doc:
Demo/test model of the framework's test project: a book with a title, written by one `Author`.

- `title` (text, max. 255 characters); `author` → `Author` (required).
- Has no permission checks: anyone, even anonymous users, may read, create, edit and delete books.
- Deleted automatically when its `Author` is deleted.
- Besides the full form there is a named form `test` that edits only `title`.
- The list search matches `title` or the author's `name`.
- Edited in `<book-edit>`.

BookContent.doc:
Demo/test model of the framework's test project: an uploaded file that belongs to one user.

- `text`: the uploaded file; `user` → the owning user.
- If `user` is left empty on save, the currently logged-in user becomes the owner.
- Only logged-in users may access it, and each user sees and changes only their own records.
- Deleting the user also deletes the user's `BookContent` records.
